class.name: CbReaction
class.brief_description: Reacts to the game with no code: on a cue, or while conditions hold, it changes how things look.
class.description: Put it in any scene the game draws (a held item, a character, a prop) or in a [code]vfx/reactions_*.tscn[/code]. A [CbDirector] above it runs it from cues (events: [code]melee.hit[/code] at an entity) and entity state ([code]melee.hot[/code] = true). Every node path may start with an anchor: [code]^[/code] my entity, [code]^^[/code] the entity above it (a held item's holder), [code]$at[/code] and [code]$other[/code] the cue's entities, [code]$local[/code] the viewer, [code]$world[/code] the director; [code]$local@pickup.target[/code] is the entity whose id is in that state field. Then an ordinary path: [code]^^/RightHand/Item[/code], [code]$other/Head[/code]. Looks only: it never changes the game itself, and no path leaves the director. Try reactions without a server in the Cue Preview bottom panel.

method.name: fire
method.description: Acts now, as if a cue came, without checking the cue or the conditions.

method.name: set_on
method.description: Turns a "while" on or off by hand (the director does this every frame).

members.member: On a cue: acts once per cue named [member event]. While: on as long as [member conditions] hold, and undoes what it did when they stop.

The cue's name: a mod's event ([code]melee.hit[/code]), the game's ([code]footstep[/code], [code]jumped[/code], [code]landed[/code], [code]impact[/code], [code]spawned[/code], [code]destroying[/code]). For the viewer's own key press to show at once, add a [CbPrediction] that names the cue the server will send.

A: the cue happened at the subject ([code]melee.hit[/code] is at the attacker). B: the subject is the other entity the cue names (the victim). Either: both. Ignored when [member subject] starts with [code]$at[/code] or [code]$other[/code].

Whose state plain condition names read, and who the cue must name. Empty is [code]^[/code] (my entity). [code]^^[/code]: my holder. [code]$at[/code] / [code]$other[/code]: whoever any cue of this name names (world reactions).
Only when the subject is this kind of entity: [code]player[/code], [code]prop[/code], [code]static[/code], [code]ragdoll[/code], [code]item[/code]. Empty or [code]any[/code]: all.
Only when the subject comes from this template (a map template's name; an item's kind: [code]melee.bat[/code]).

All must hold. [code]name[/code] / [code]!name[/code] (not zero / zero), [code]?name[/code] (known), comparisons ([code]pistol.ammo > 0[/code]). A path and a colon read another entity: [code]^^:combat.dead[/code], [code]$world:deathmatch.round[/code]. Also [code]is_local[/code], [code]event.value[/code], [code]event.strength[/code].
Cue reactions: act this many seconds after the cue.
Cue reactions: how often it acts, from 0 to 1 (0.3: about a third of the cues).
At least this many seconds between two firings: twenty props landing at once play one sound.

When a [CbPrediction] plays this cue on the viewer's own press, do not act then: act when the server's cue comes. For what must stay in step with something the server starts, like flames along a bat and the body's swing.
The AnimationPlayer that plays [member animation] ([code]../AnimationPlayer[/code]). Looks only: bone tracks on a player's body are overwritten by the game's pose.
Played from the start when it acts.
Played when a "while" ends. Without one, [member animation] stops.
The node whose [member property] is set, or whose [member method] is called: [code]../Barrel[/code], [code]^^/Head[/code].
The property to set; sub-paths work: [code]visible[/code], [code]surface_material_override/0:emission_energy_multiplier[/code]. A "while" puts the old value back when it ends.
What [member property] becomes.
Fade to [member value] (and back, when a "while" ends) over this many seconds. Numbers, vectors and colours; anything else changes at once.

A method of [member target] to call: [code]restart[/code], [code]play[/code], [code]set_visible[/code]. Only listed methods are called: [code]restart[/code], [code]play[/code], [code]play_backwards[/code], [code]stop[/code], [code]pause[/code], [code]queue[/code], [code]seek[/code], [code]advance[/code], [code]show[/code], [code]hide[/code], [code]set_visible[/code], [code]set_emitting[/code], [code]set_text[/code], [code]set_value[/code], [code]set_frame[/code], [code]set_modulate[/code], [code]set_volume_db[/code], [code]set_pitch_scale[/code], [code]set_speed_scale[/code]. For anything else, set a [member property].
[member method]'s arguments: [code]["slash"][/code], [code][false][/code].
A scene to add: particles, a decal, a light. One-shot particles restart, so the burst always plays.
Where [member scene] goes when [member place] is "Under its parent". Empty: next to this reaction.
Seconds before a cue's scene is freed. A "while"'s scene goes when the "while" ends.

Where the scene and the sound go: under its parent, at the cue's point or end (where a shot ended), a beam from [member place_node] (or the point) to the end, at [member place_node], or following the subject.
For "At place_node" and "Beam": [code]$at/RightHand[/code], [code]$other/Head[/code].
Added to where the scene and the sound go.
A sound, once, where [member place] puts it. For variety, use an AudioStreamRandomizer.
The sound's volume.
The sound's pitch.
A random ± added to [member pitch_scale] each time.
The audio bus. Empty: the default.
Silent beyond this distance. 0: the default falloff.
Camera shake strength. The viewer's: add the condition [code]is_local[/code] for what only the affected player should feel.
Seconds the shake takes to fade.
A full-screen flash; its alpha is the strength. The viewer's, like [member shake].
Seconds the flash takes to fade.

constants.constant: The cue happened at the subject.
The subject is the other entity the cue names.
At the cue's end (where a shot ended).
A one-metre scene stretched from place_node (or the point) to the end.
